notes_id: Pembaruan EasyFaceless Studio 1.0.1: mode Campur Terbaik paralel lintas sumber footage, pencocokan Local files lebih akurat dengan pengunggah multi-file, ekspor prompt & impor gambar massal untuk alat eksternal, preset gambar Together AI dan DeepInfra dengan Uji 1 gambar, serta dukungan CapCut 9.7.1.
notes_en: EasyFaceless Studio 1.0.1 update: parallel Mix Best footage search across active sources, smarter Local files matching with multi-file upload, External Image Bridge prompt export and bulk import, Together AI and DeepInfra image presets with 1-image tester, and tested support for CapCut 9.7.1.
